name: Kimpton Armory Hotel
insider_take: A converted National Guard Armory turned chic boutique hotel in the heart of Big Sky Country
whats_special: This unique property occupies a historic 1915 brick armory building, preserving original architectural elements like soaring ceilings and exposed brick walls. Located in downtown Bozeman, you're perfectly positioned between world-class skiing at Big Sky Resort (45 minutes) and Yellowstone National Park (90 minutes). The hotel's design pays homage to its military heritage while embracing Montana's outdoor culture.
pro_tip: Book during Bozeman's "shoulder seasons" (May-June or September-October) for the best rates and perfect weather for exploring both Yellowstone and the surrounding Gallatin Valley without the summer crowds.
dont_miss: The hotel's evening wine hour featuring local Montana wines, and be sure to explore Main Street's vibrant dining scene just steps away. The nearby Museum of the Rockies houses one of the world's largest T-Rex skull collections, while the Gallatin River offers world-renowned fly fishing practically at your doorstep.
pros: Historic boutique property with unique character and charm
Prime downtown Bozeman location within walking distance to restaurants and attractions
Exceptional personalized service with Kimpton's signature hospitality
Pet-friendly accommodations with no additional fees
cons: Higher price point typical of boutique properties
